competitiveTarget: Utility comparison page: side-by-side property table. noindex — not an SEO surface. KB (kinetic-brutalist) design system: navy header band with Amboqia display H1, cream comparison surface, hard --edge borders, KbNav + KbFooter chrome.
note: KB conversion 2026-06-18 (Phase 9 convergence) — RESTYLED IN PLACE, no content dropped. KbNav + KbFooter carry chrome (HideChrome to suppress default SiteHeader/SiteFooter is a shared-component edit deferred to the orchestrator). The interactive comparison surface (photo row + side-by-side feature Table + best-in-class highlighting + Google Maps locations embed + Copy Link/Download PDF actions + empty/loading state) is unchanged in CompareClient — only the page-level chrome and header were restyled to KB. Data still via @/lib/data DAL only (getListingTiles by listNumbers AND listingKeys + getListingDetailPhotos). robots noindex,follow preserved; route is NOT in the sitemap. Breadcrumb JSON-LD only (no WebPage JSON-LD on a noindex utility route). No KbHero — a stock cinematic hero is off-brand for a utility tool; a compact navy header band carries the breadcrumb + H1 + intro. AICompare is built but not wired — see inline wire-or-delete note in page.tsx.
